text:
Priya (Design): Quick copy check for the 'Delete evaluation suites' bulk action. Current modal: 'Delete selected? This cannot be undone.' Feels terse.
Omar (Product): Agreed. Need clarity on scope: does it delete results, configs, linked prompts? Users should know.
Priya (Design): Proposed body: 'Permanently delete the selected evaluation suites and all their results. This cannot be undone.' Helper: 'Deleted suites can be recreated, but past results will be lost.'
Diego (Frontend): UX: We show counts like '3 suites, 120 results' if available. Should the helper call out counts when present?
Priya (Design): Yes, show counts if available. If not, use plural list. CTA: 'Delete suites' (red), Secondary: 'Cancel'.
Marta (Accessibility): A11y notes: modal needs role=dialog and focus trap. For destructive action consider adding a required checkbox 'I understand this will permanently delete results.' Might be overkill for small batches.
Omar (Product): Decision: no typing confirm for now. Add optional checkbox only shown when >10 suites or >1000 results. Also add undo toast for 20s.
Diego (Frontend): I'll implement copy, counts when available, checkbox logic, and undo toast with aria-live='assertive'.
Priya (Design): Tiny copy tweak: change helper to 'This action will permanently remove past results and cannot be undone.'
Marta (Accessibility): Ensure undo button has aria-label 'Undo delete evaluation suites' and focus returns to bulk action menu after close.
Omar (Product): ACTIONS: Diego to PR, Priya update Figma, Marta add SR test.
Priya (Design): I'll add final strings to PR desc. :white_check_mark:
